thesis.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png: 37 strips in the accords' own colours are the screen and the thesis reads at once; mock-fragrance-dark.png repeats it as one tall strip. shelf-dark.png and fragrance-light.png are neutral text lists with no scent colour, so the renderer screens carry only the type and chrome.

signature.evidence: mock-shelf-light.png: the barcode-like spectrum with the focused strip risen and a tick under it is born from the accord data and survives the logo being covered. It exists only in the mocks; shelf-light.png has no trace of it.

content.evidence: mock-fragrance-light.png: notes as three tiered swatch rows, accords as one weighted labelled bar, 8.5 as one numeral; mock-shelf-dark.png: format split bar. mock-add-fragrance-dark.png: the typed accord string becomes its chord live. shelf-dark.png still lists fragrances as 'House: Name (accords)' text.

hierarchy.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png: strips, then Harvest Moon, then the five accord labels, with Add as a bold word top right. The 37 numeral nearly competes with the name for first read, but the order holds. mock-add-fragrance-light.png: title, fields, chord strip in a clear order.

type.evidence: mock-shelf-light.png and mock-add-fragrance-dark.png: heavy tight grotesque for 37, Harvest Moon and the title against small sentence-case Inter Tight; no tracked caps remain in shelf-dark.png or fragrance-dark.png. Facts sit at one weight and one muted ink, so the third level is a little flat.

colour.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png and mock-shelf-light.png: scent colour at full strength on a one-ink ground in both modes, dark ground a step off black. mock-fragrance-dark.png: accord labels now take dark ink on pastel segments. Near-ground strips such as the dark grey Parfums de Marly strip rely on a thin edge.

restraint.evidence: mock-shelf-light.png: no boxes, no radius, no shadow; one idea. mock-fragrance-light.png: the one hairline above My notes is the only rule. The three grey squares at the top left of every mock (mock-shelf-dark.png) are decoration with no job.

craft.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png: the house-group tick lines run through the label text (Scents of Wood, Day Three, House of Cosmo) and labels stagger across three rows, so the baseline reads ragged. shelf-dark.png and fragrance-dark.png: Add fragrance and Save sit at x=431 against a 406 text edge, and the window dots touch the left edge. mock-fragrance-dark.png: the lower-left and mid column are empty.

distinct.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png and mock-fragrance-light.png are recognisably this product with the name hidden. shelf-light.png and add-fragrance-light.png are a centred single column, which direction.md section 8 declares a renderer limit, so I score the mocks.

owner-fit.evidence: mock-shelf-dark.png is a loud, structural, colour-keeping answer to 'cheap' and 'even simpler'; there are no grey boxes in any mock. kit-dark.png pressed states are now dimmed text and the grey slabs are gone.

generic: Centred single-column text-list layout with a stacked Show / Search label pair in the rendered screens (shelf-dark.png, shelf-light.png)
Underlined form fields and a small grey label above every value in the add form (add-fragrance-light.png, mock-add-fragrance-light.png)
Three grey squares plus a plain 'Shelf' back label as the window chrome in every mock (mock-fragrance-light.png, mock-shelf-dark.png)

fixes.text: Group tick lines cut through labels and labels stagger over three rows; put every house label on one row below its group, 6px right of the tick, and drop the label for groups too narrow to hold it.
Align Add fragrance and Save to the 406px text edge instead of 431px, and move the window dots in from the left edge.
The 37 numeral rivals the focused fragrance name; reduce 37 by a third or mute its ink so the name is the first read after the strips.
The right half beyond the chord strip is empty; set the empty-shelf wording or the format choice there, or move the strip to the right edge.
Remove the three grey squares in the top-left window chrome, or give them a job.
Lower-left below the scent strip and middle column are empty; place the format and sampler line there or cut the strip to the content height.
